title: go in, fall off, run away etc. (phrasal verbs 1)
summary: Фразовые глаголы без дополнения: **get up, sit down, come back, go out, run away, fall off** — глагол + короткое слово, которое меняет или уточняет значение.
ru:
## Что такое фразовый глагол
Это глагол + маленькое слово (**in, out, up, down, on, off, away, back**). Вместе они дают новое значение: **go out** — выйти, **come back** — вернуться, **sit down** — сесть.
> She **got up** at seven. — Она встала в семь.
> Please **sit down**. — Пожалуйста, садитесь.
> The thief **ran away**. — Вор убежал.

## Фразовые глаголы без дополнения
В этом юните — глаголы, после которых не нужен предмет: сам глагол + слово уже заканчивают мысль.

## Самые частые
- **get up** — вставать: *I get up at 6.*
- **sit down / stand up** — сесть / встать: *Everyone stood up.*
- **come in / go in** — войти: *Come in, please!*
- **come out / go out** — выйти, пойти гулять: *Are you going out tonight?*
- **come back / go back** — вернуться: *When will you come back?*
- **run away** — убежать: *The dog ran away.*
- **fall off / fall down** — упасть: *He fell off his bike.*
- **hurry up** — поторопиться: *Hurry up! We're late.*
- **wake up** — проснуться: *I woke up early.*
- **grow up** — вырасти: *She grew up in Osh.*
- **look out** — осторожно: *Look out! There's a car!*
- **take off / land** — взлетать / приземляться: *The plane took off at nine.*
- **turn round** — повернуться: *She turned round and smiled.*

## Фразовый глагол + предлог
Иногда после фразового глагола идёт ещё предлог + место:
> He **fell off** his bike. (не ~~fell off from~~)
> The cat **jumped out of** the box.
> She **came back to** Bishkek last week.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I woke up at six o'clock and get up.~~ → I woke up and **got up**.
- ~~He is sit down.~~ → He **is sitting down** / He **sat down**.
- ~~Come to in!~~ → **Come in!**
- ~~She grew in Osh.~~ → She **grew up** in Osh.
en:
## What is a phrasal verb?
A verb + a small word (**in, out, up, down, on, off, away, back**). Together they have a new meaning: **go out**, **come back**, **sit down**.
> She **got up** at seven.
> Please **sit down**.
> The thief **ran away**.

## Phrasal verbs without an object
In this unit the verb + small word is complete. We don't need a noun after it.

## Common ones
- **get up**: *I get up at 6.*
- **sit down / stand up**: *Everyone stood up.*
- **come in / go in**: *Come in, please!*
- **come out / go out**: *Are you going out tonight?*
- **come back / go back**: *When will you come back?*
- **run away**: *The dog ran away.*
- **fall off / fall down**: *He fell off his bike.*
- **hurry up**: *Hurry up! We're late.*
- **wake up**: *I woke up early.*
- **grow up**: *She grew up in Osh.*
- **look out**: *Look out! There's a car!*
- **take off / land**: *The plane took off at nine.*
- **turn round**: *She turned round and smiled.*

## With a preposition
Sometimes a preposition + place follows:
> He **fell off** his bike.
> The cat **jumped out of** the box.
> She **came back to** Bishkek last week.

## Common mistakes
- ~~Come to in!~~ → **Come in!**
- ~~She grew in Osh.~~ → She **grew up** in Osh.
- ~~He is sit down.~~ → He **sat down.**
structure:
## Формула
> Подлежащее + **глагол + частица**
> I **get up** at seven. · The plane **took off**.
> Подлежащее + **глагол + частица** + предлог + место
> She **came back to** Osh. · He **fell off** the horse.

## Частые пары
| Фразовый глагол | Значение |
|---|---|
| get up | вставать |
| sit down | сесть |
| stand up | встать |
| come in / go in | войти |
| come out / go out | выйти |
| come back / go back | вернуться |
| run away | убежать |
| fall off / fall down | упасть |
| hurry up | торопиться |
| wake up | проснуться |
| grow up | вырасти |

## Вопрос и отрицание
> Do you **get up** early? — No, I **don't get up** before eight.
> Did he **come back**? — Yes, he **came back** yesterday.

## Запомните
- Глагол меняется (get → got), а частица остаётся: **get up → got up**.
- Значение часто не равно сумме слов: **look out** = «осторожно!».

exercises.title: Выберите фразовый глагол
exercises.instruction: Вставьте глагол в нужной форме: **get up, sit down, come in, go out, come back, run away, fall off, hurry up**.

items.text: Please {{sit down}}. The doctor will see you soon.
The boy {{fell off}} his bike and hurt his knee.
She {{went out}} with her friends last night.
The cat saw the dog and {{ran away}}.
I'm leaving now, but I'll {{come back|be back|go back}} at five.

exercises.title: Что за частица?
exercises.instruction: Вставьте слово: **up, down, out, in, off, away, back**.

items.text: I woke {{up}} at seven and got up.
She went to Moscow, but now she's come {{back}}.
He stood {{up}} to give his seat to an old lady.

items.why: Past simple от get up → **got up**.

items.q: He ___ his horse and broke his arm.
Where did you ___? — I grew up in Naryn.
My dog ___ yesterday and I can't find it.

options: I grew up in a village.
I growed up in a village.
He fell off from the tree.

exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями о себе. Проверьте по образцу.

items.prompt: What time do you get up?
items.sample: I get up at seven o'clock.

items.prompt: Do you go out in the evening? Where?
